gemini.performance_metric: deregistered in April 2020; no public in-window record
gemini.rationale: The company was taken private and deregistered in early 2020, meaning there is no public record for the 3-5 year post-deal window. Thus, any realized disruption at the product/process or process/organization interfaces cannot be observed, making p4_pathway and p5_pathway uncertain.

grok.rationale: The slice states that the Company was delisted in March 2020 and deregistered in April 2020, with no Form 10-K filed thereafter, so no public audited annual record exists for the fixed ~2020–2022 outcome window and the in-window realized record is not publicly observable. Consequently the slice supplies no evidence on which to determine whether product/process interface disruption (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5) was realized over that horizon; both are therefore coded uncertain. Pre-window FY2019 scalars and sponsor notes cannot substitute for the missing in-window trajectory.
